title: Etsy reports Q3 revenue up 11% YoY to $692.5M, above $668M est., net income of $853.5M after selling Depop, and gross merchandise sales up 9% YoY to $2.65B (Katherine Hamilton/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Katherine Hamilton / Wall Street Journal: Etsy reports Q3 revenue up 11% YoY to $692.5M, above $668M est., net income of $853.5M after selling Depop, and gross merchandise sales up 9% YoY to $2.65B — The online marketplace operator's revenue rose 11% to 692.5 million in the third quarter — Etsy logged higher sales in the third quarter …
contentText:
Katherine Hamilton / Wall Street Journal :

Etsy reports Q3 revenue up 11% YoY to $692.5M, above $668M est., net income of $853.5M after selling Depop, and gross merchandise sales up 9% YoY to $2.65B   —  The online marketplace operator's revenue rose 11% to 692.5 million in the third quarter  —  Etsy logged higher sales in the third quarter …
